statement: Pinned Eden Joy-Con NFC consumer enters MCU report 0x31, enables MCU, waits for standby and NFC-ready, starts polling, detects a tag by NFC state, reads indexed response fragments until a terminal state, and for writes verifies target identity, enters write-ready, sends indexed data and waits for write-done. Tag-loss and timeouts are error paths.

applicability.scope: Protocol-level consumer flow only; no tag content, NFC keys, retail interoperability or actual operation captured.
